releaseNotes: Fixed: UI Scale no longer locks the game at 75% or 125%
Fixed: switching a character skin while a themed set is worn
Fixed: emotes now work in LAN matches, not just online queue matches
Fixed: a new account no longer silently starts with the Astro board and barricade
Account menu moved to the right of the Home top bar and no longer overflows
Reduced barrier thickness and move-guide arrow size on the board
Loading screen tip text is now readable over any background
Featured Skin card on Home now aligns with the other cards
Emote picker tiles are larger and unboxed
New: in-app update checking is now live
